course.title: Transportation Planning
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: It is observed that on an average a vehicle driver drives 5,000 km during the course of a year. The probability of having an accident is 100 per 200 million vehicle-kilometers. What is the probability of a driver having at least 3 accidents during his driving career extending to 25 years?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
